remarks: Back on market - financing fell through...Charming Pre-War Garden Complex in the Heart of Stamford! Step into old-world charm with this ivy-covered, pre-war brick walk-up set on beautifully landscaped, manicured grounds. Mature trees and lush plantings create a peaceful, park-like atmosphere that feels miles away-yet you're only steps from Stamford's vibrant downtown, filled with dining, shopping, and entertainment. This spacious corner one-bedroom residence, on the 2nd floor, is flooded with natural light and showcases gleaming hardwood floors, soaring 9-foot ceilings, and a thoughtfully updated kitchen that opens seamlessly to the living and dining areas. The oversized bedroom features added ceiling insulation for restful, quiet nights. Enjoy summer evenings on the lawn or join in one of the community's many social gatherings in the serene courtyards. If you have a green thumb, you'll love the opportunity to cultivate your own flowers, herbs, or vegetables in the shared garden plots. Experience the perfect blend of historic charm, modern comfort, and community living-all in the heart of Stamford. Additional amenities include: Limited indoor parking available ($50/month) Pet-friendly (with restrictions) Extra storage options, ample off-street parking, on-site debit card opperated laundry with new machines and 5 oversized in-unit closets. Rental Restrictions: Owner occupancy for 1 year before renting. Please use Binder of Sale or Purchase Agreement for all offers.
